name: folio-policy-driven-pdf-object-validation
instr:
folio cannot validate PDF object graphs consistently across construction, reading, resolution, decryption, and writing. Apply one explicit policy to any PdfObject and return every distinct defect in deterministic validation-path order without mutation.

Make validation cycle-safe for shared graphs. Report invalid dictionary keys, forbidden null values, and nested failures at stable key-addressed paths. Distinguish malformed names, numbers, and strings while sharing codes, severities, issues, and paths. ParseWithOptions applies the selected validation policy across the parsed object graph and returns findings with stable indirect-object-number and nested-location provenance. Validate encryption dictionaries before authentication. Validate the final indirect object graph, including stream dictionaries, lengths, and reference targets, before writer transformations, identity deduplication, renumbering, cross-reference creation, or any destination output; rejection returns one structured ValidationError without partial output. Equivalent defects found during construction, reading, decryption, and writing must have matching codes and severities with comparable path suffixes. Explicit validation must compose only with selected transformations and expose deterministically ordered findings in report mode; the selected policy independently controls reporting and rejection severity without changing any defect's path. Export ValidationMode, ValidationCode, ValidationPolicy, ValidationPat
